messages:
emma_pm: Heads-up: prioritization workshop today 10m. Need a minimal launch plan for routing + multi-region isolation that we can take to Sales for pilot commitments. Focus: acceptable SLAs, tiers, and a clear onramp.

anil_arch: Proposal in 2 lines: define a Policy DSL + 3 isolation primitives (shared, soft-slice, reserved). DSL should express precedence, affinity, and failover strategy. Example: 

```json
{
  "route": "api.generate",
  "isolation": "soft-slice",
  "precedence": ["region_pin", "latency", "cost"],
  "affinity": {"kv_locality": true},
  "failover": {"mode": "gradual", "max_spill": 0.1}
}
```

rafa_infra: Implementation constraints: token bucket per-tenant, queue isolation per-priority, and a capacity preview API for sales. For reserved pools we need quota tokens tied to billing. Also note cross-region cache warmup takes ~30s per model shard.

tomo_sre: Runbook checklist: (1) cross-region failover playbook, (2) automated rollback thresholds (error_rate > 0.5% or 99p latency > 500ms triggers), (3) residency checks during failover. Need synthetic failover test in staging every deploy.

claire_sales: Sales input: pilots need explicit SLA percentages and credits. Enterprise pilots will want region pin + dedicated lanes. Mid-market pilots prefer soft-slice with lower cost. We can sign 2 pilots if we commit to a clear migration window and a one-week performance baseline.

emma_pm: Good. Draft launch acceptance criteria (summary): must have doc + runbook, policy-DSL draft, telemetry dashboards (latency percentiles and queued depth), two paying pilots (enterprise + mid-market), capacity-preview API, and billing hook for reserved lanes. Acceptance gates: error_rate < 0.4% over 7d, 99p latency < 300ms, successful synthetic failover test.

anil_arch: Also recommend a phased rollout: alpha internal tenants -> closed pilot (2 customers) -> opt-in GA. Keep fallback to cheaper model automated but observable.

rafa_infra: Action items tracked: quota system (owner @rafa_infra), policy-DSL spec (@anil_arch), telemetry dashboards (@tomo_sre), pilot onboarding doc (@claire_sales). Target: pilot signups by end of Q3, pilot start early Q4.

pr-bot: CI: policy-dsl spec PR opened by anil_arch #3421, auto-test job scheduled.

emma_pm: I'll post the consolidated PRD after the workshop. If anyone has blocking concerns, ping me directly. :sparkles:
